items: Each essence rises from a wellspring and flows through the Dreamlands as a river. Compounds form where rivers meet. Where opposites meet, raw lucidity erupts. What each essence is like lives on the Essences tab.

rows: The spring of Memory, which Orphic gold tablets told the dead to drink from instead of Lethe
Underworld river whose water makes the dead forget their lives
Primordial darkness born of Chaos; with Night, the parent of Aether and Day
The bright upper air where the gods breathe; child of Erebus and Night
